input.reasoning_summary:
The verdict has changed from INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE to CONTRADICTED based on the newly retrieved full-year FY2025 data.

Challenge H1 is SUPPORTED: The evidence shows Intel's total consolidated revenue actually DECREASED from $53,101 million in FY2024 to $52,853 million in FY2025 (a decline of $248 million or approximately 0.47%). This contradicts the claim's premise of a "revenue recovery" - there was no recovery, but rather a revenue decline.

Challenge H2 is SUPPORTED: The evidence shows CCG revenue DECREASED from $33,346 million in FY2024 to $32,228 million in FY2025 (a decline of $1,118 million or approximately 3.4%). In contrast, DCAI revenue INCREASED from $16,125 million to $16,919 million (an increase of $794 million or approximately 4.9%). This contradicts the claim that CCG "led" any recovery - CCG actually declined while DCAI grew.

Challenge H3 found NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE of any filing statement explicitly attributing a FY2025 revenue recovery to CCG.

The claim is CONTRADICTED on two material grounds: (1) there was no revenue recovery in FY2025 - total revenue declined; and (2) CCG did not lead any positive performance - it declined while DCAI grew.
